questions: How do I change a string to uppercase?
How to convert text to lowercase?
answer: Use .upper() to make a string uppercase and .lower() to make it lowercase, e.g. 'hello'.upper() gives 'HELLO'. Strings are immutable, so these methods return a new string.

questions: How do I put a variable inside a string?
How to format a string in Python?
answer: An f-string lets you embed values directly in text. Put f before the quotes and wrap variables in braces, e.g. name = 'Ali'; print(f'Hello {name}').
